tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find local businesses that take bookings: salons, massage, doctors, trainers, yoga classes, courts, scooter/car/boat rental, home services, tours. Filter by text, city/country or coordinates and category. Awning does not guess where the user is from the request — it comes from your servers — so pass

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full card of one business: offerings with prices, extras, booking rules, intake questions, hours, cancellation policy, contacts. demo: true marks a sample listing that is not a real place.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Real free time for one offering. Slots mode returns start times; sessions mode returns classes with seats left; period mode (rentals) checks from/to and units left. Always call this instead of guessing from opening hours.

tools.name: create_hold
tools.description: Reserves the chosen time, seats or units for 10 minutes and fixes the price. Pass `start` (slots), `session_id` (sessions) or `from`+`to` (rentals). Then show the user time, price and cancellation policy and ask for an explicit yes before create_booking.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a REAL booking from a hold. Call only after the user explicitly confirmed time and price. Needs the user's name and at least one contact: phone, email or Telegram. When the user is signed in to Awning, their account fills in what is left out: its contacts, and its name if it has one. Pass th

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Status of a booking. Pass the manage_token from manage_url, or nothing if the user is signed in and the booking is theirs.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking under the business cancellation policy. Confirm with the user first and tell them whether a late fee applies.

tools.name: my_bookings
tools.description: The signed-in user's bookings across all businesses. Asks the user to sign in to Awning if they are not.

tools.name: my_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's profile, or update name, phone, language or where to send notifications (email or telegram).

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Signs the user out of Awning in this assistant. With everywhere=true, signs out of every assistant and device.

tools.name: owner_import_source
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Give it the address of a page the business already has — their website, a listing, a public profile — and it returns the readable text and candidate photos. Read them, fill in everything you can and send it in one owner_setup call, then ask the owner onl

tools.name: owner_setup
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Guided onboarding run by Awning. Convert the owner's natural-language description, prices and hours into structured answers, including separate hour ranges for breaks. Do not invent missing details; ask to clarify ambiguous days, times or timezone. Keep

tools.name: owner_photos
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Save photos for the business page using supported chat attachments in files or downloadable image links in urls. Called with nothing, returns an upload widget where supported and upload_url as a fallback. The response lists the photos the page has now in

tools.name: owner_remove_photos
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Take photos off the business page, or out of a business being set up, by photo_id from owner_photos current. The files are deleted. Confirm with the owner which ones first.

tools.name: owner_preview
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Shows how clients will see the business (draft or existing) and what blocks submission.

tools.name: owner_submit
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Submits the finished onboarding (or a corrected business after rejection) for review. A new location of a live business, by an owner Awning already knows, goes live at once: report the returned status as it is. Confirm with the owner first.

tools.name: owner_status
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Status of the owner's businesses and applications, pending requests count, a new name waiting for Awning's review (pending_rename), unfinished draft.

tools.name: owner_list_bookings
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Requests waiting for a decision first, then bookings in the period (default: next 7 days), with client contacts.

tools.name: owner_get_schedule
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Day or week view per staff member, room or rental pool: bookings, classes, blocked time and free windows.

tools.name: owner_decide_booking
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. confirm / decline (with reason) / quote (with price) a pending request; complete or no_show after the visit. Confirm with the owner before declining. The client is notified.

tools.name: owner_cancel_booking
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Cancels a booking on behalf of the business and notifies the client. Always ask the owner to confirm first.

tools.name: owner_block_time
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Close time (day off, break, holiday) for the whole business or one staff member/room, or open extra time with open=true. Remove a block with remove_exception_id. Confirm with the owner first.

tools.name: owner_pause
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Temporarily stop taking new bookings (paused=true) or resume (paused=false). Existing bookings stay.

tools.name: owner_update_business
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Change name, description, street address and its map point, public contacts, cancellation rules or automatic confirmation. Pass lat and lng with a new address when you know them; without them the old map point is dropped. A new name for a live business i

tools.name: owner_set_schedule
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Replace weekly hours of the business, or of one staff member/room with resource_id. Existing bookings are kept.

tools.name: owner_update_offering
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Change name, description, duration, price, advance booking or cleanup time, or archive it. Confirm with the owner first; archiving cannot be undone.

tools.name: owner_add_offering
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Add a new offering to a business the owner already has, live or not, described the same way as in owner_setup. On a live business it can be booked at once. Confirm the details with the owner first; never invent a price.

tools.name: owner_upsert_sessions
tools.description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Set when a class runs; future classes are generated for the booking horizon.

tools.name: op_connect_telegram
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. Create a link to bind your Telegram to your signed-in operator account. Open it yourself and confirm in the bot. A server administrator must also allow your numeric ID in OPERATOR_TELEGRAM_IDS before moderation is enabled.

tools.description: Only for the Awning team. approve publishes the business; reject needs a note the owner will see. To approve an application of any route but rename, pass expected_name: the business's name exactly as op_applications showed it to you (business.name). tools.name: op_leads
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. Businesses that left their details on the join page but have not filled the questionnaire yet.

tools.name: op_decide_lead
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. invite emails the business how to set the listing up from their own assistant; close drops the enquiry with an optional note for us.

tools.name: op_analytics
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. How the website is doing over the last days. people: visitors in browsers from Umami — totals against the previous period, top pages, sources, channels, countries, devices, and events such as lead_form_started / lead_form_field / lead_form_submitted (how far people get with

tools.name: op_businesses
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. Every business on Awning with its status (live, waiting for approval, needs changes, not submitted, suspended), who runs it, and a link: the public page when live, the private preview otherwise. Filter by status or by part of the name.

tools.name: op_suspend_business
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. Hide a business from clients, e.g. on complaints or an ownership dispute.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "owner_photos" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Save photos for the business page using supported chat attachments in files or downloadable image links in urls. C…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "owner_photos" is 1217 chars, far longer than this server's median (207). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Save photos for the business page using supported chat attachments in files or downloadable image links in urls. C…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_profile, op_decide_application · Private data: get_business, create_booking, owner_photos, owner_remove_photos, owner_list_bookings, owner_update_business, op_applications, op_businesses · Public sink: create_booking, my_profile, owner_import_source, owner_setup, owner_photos, owner_submit, op_analytics · Destructive: owner_setup, owner_remove_photos, owner_block_time, op_analytics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_profile, op_decide_application · Private data: get_business, create_booking, owner_photos, owner_remove_photos, owner_list_bookings, owner_update_business, op_applications, op_businesses · Public sink: create_booking, my_profile, owner_import_source, owner_setup, owner_photos, owner_submit, op_analytics · Destructive: owner_setup, owner_remove_photos, owner_block_time, op_analytics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
